name: Flywheel-Governor Hub
core_rationale: Central centrifugal-governor sanctuary town of Flywheel Dynamo Canyon at [1, 1] where wind-tinkers regulate the twin hundred-meter flywheels above the Kinetic Ballast Vault.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Polished brass oil-cushion basins stabilizing the central centrifugal governor spire

North.lock_message: Centrifugal wind-shear across Gyroscope-Rim Overlook buffets uncalibrated gliders; Governor-Master Torque requires the Flywheel Ballast Key before unlocking the northern rim bridge.

resident_npcs.name: Governor-Master Torque
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Flywheel-Governor Hub! Step up to my 0.58 meter brass governor console—our twin flywheels store enough wind energy to light the entire steppe.

resident_npcs.name: Ballast-Smith Korin
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Kinetic Ballast Vault, an overloaded flywheel colossus guards the Flywheel Ballast Key needed for Gyroscope-Rim Overlook!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Flywheel Dynamo Canyon at [1, 1] directly above Krono's Kinetic Ballast Vault and connects west to Centrifugal Gantry Span.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Brass centrifugal-governor sanctuary suspended between twin hundred-meter spinning flywheel discs.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m governor consoles, 0.14m brass cog-risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Gyroscope-Rim Overlook behind a Fog of Lore portal requiring the Flywheel Ballast Key.
